title: 프레디 오르티스와 리네트 오르티스: 가족이 함께 사탄의 공격에 맞서다

ko.text: 코네티컷 주 뉴브리튼에서 오신 오르티스 형제 부부를 스튜디오에 초대했습니다.
여러 해 동안 많은 부가적인 봉사의 특권을 수행해 왔습니다.
리네트 자매는 6년 넘게 정규 파이오니아로 일했습니다.
두 분이 가족에 대한 사탄의 공격에 지금까지 성공적으로 맞서 왔기 때문입니다.
어떻게 그럴 수 있었는지 듣고 싶은데요.
우선 형제가 가족 소개를 좀 해 주시죠.
저희 둘 다 진리 안에서 자라지 않았어요.
증인이 아닐 때 만나 사랑하게 됐죠.
당시 전 결혼할 입장이 아니어서 우린 2년간 연애만 하다가
얼마 안 되 둘 다 성서 연구 시작했죠.
일주일에 두 번씩 했고 진리라는 걸 알게 되었습니다.
하지만 여호와께서 부도덕을 어떻게 보시는지 배우면서
아내 부모님이 아내가 계속 세속 교육을 받길 원했어요.
저흰 행실을 변화할 필요가 있었고 2년이 지나 필요한 조정을 했습니다.
성경 원칙은 따를 만한 가치가 있습니다.
오르티스 자매, 진리 밖에서 자랐다고 하셨는데,
가족이 훌륭한 기초를 쌓고 성공적이 되게 하기 위해
두 분 다 어떤 변화가 필요했나요?
침례를 받기 전에, 남편은 음주 문제가 심각했어요.
또 자란 배경 때문에, 저희는 질투심이 많았고,
서로에 대한 확신이나 신뢰가 많이 부족했습니다.
감사하게도 연구 사회자가 저희 두 사람과
「행복한 가정을 이루는 길」 책을 공부하자고 제안했고,
저흰 그 책을 두 번이나 연구했어요.
이 출판물과 그 안에 든 성경 원칙들이
지금 저희가 즐기는 행복한 결혼 생활의 기초가 되었습니다.
그러면, 오르티스 형제가 자녀들에 관해서 좀 이야기를 해 주시겠습니까?
큰 아들 게이브리얼은 열네 살 때 정규 파이오니아를 시작했고,
열여덟 살 때 봉사의 종으로 임명됐습니다.
스물두 살인데 지금까지 2년 넘게 워릭 현장 배관부에서 일해 왔습니다.
마찬가지로 열네 살 때 정규 파이오니아를 시작했고,
지금은 회중 회계 일을 비롯한 다른 특권들도 즐기고 있죠.
둘 다 일찍부터 신권 경력을 쌓기 시작했군요.
조롱하는 자에게 형제의 아들들이 대답하는 걸 보고 기뻐하실 거라 확신합니다.
가정 책에 더해서 가족이 성공을 거두는 데 도움이 된 것이 또 있었나요?
중앙장로회는 많은 출판물을 통해 가족을 위한 지침을 제공해 왔죠.
그래서 궁금한 점이나 문제가 있을 때마다 늘 신속하게 결정을 내릴 수 있었어요.
서로 대화하거나 아이들에게 조언할 적절한 때를 알 수 있게 인도해 달라고도 기도하죠.
아이들의 삶과 인격 발달에는 구분되는 단계들이 있다고 들었기 때문에,
어떤 일을 예상할 수 있을지 미리 조사했어요.
그랬기 때문에 아이들의 태도나 생각이 바뀌는 걸 볼 때도 놀라지 않았습니다.
또 아이들의 성장 단계에서 어떤 문제가 있는지,
조정이나 시정이 필요한 부분이 무엇인지 알 수 있었어요.
잘 들어 주고 이해해 주는 게 얼마나 중요한지를 여러 해 동안 배웠습니다.
가족에게 얼마나 사랑하는지 매일 말해 줘요.
뒤로 미루기가 쉬운데, 얼마나 유익한지를 생각하죠.
이 마련이 있기 전에도 저희 가족은
함께 성경을 연구하는 시간을 아주 소중히 여겼습니다.
태아가 6개월만 되어도 가족의 목소리를 인지할 수 있다는 걸 알게 되었고,
그래서 아들들이 엄마 배 속에 있을 때부터 성서 연구를 시작했죠.
세속 일이나 다른 활동이 정기적인 가족 숭배를 방해할 때가 있는데,
가족 숭배를 성공적으로 하려면 그런 상황과 싸워야 했죠.
아주 좋습니다. 그런 노력이 성과가 있었군요.
형제 가족이 영적으로 얼마나 잘 해 왔고
서로 얼마나 친밀한 관계를 누리고 있는지 보면 말이죠.
고린도 전서 10:13은 우리가 ‘모든 사람이 일반적으로 겪는’ 어려움에 직면할 거라고 했죠.
저희도 가족을 부양할 때 오는 어려움들을 겪어 왔어요.
같은 성구에선 우리가 여호와의 방식대로 일을 처리하면
그분이 “빠져 나갈 길을 마련해” 주실 가능성이 높아진다는 점을 알려 주죠.
저희 가족에게 큰 변화를 초래한, 예상치 못했던 어려움 한 가지는
치료가 너무 힘들어서 남편이 많이 약해졌어요.
생활비를 절약하면서 정말 빠듯하게 살아가야 했어요.
가족과 결혼 생활에 큰 긴장이 초래되었고 영성에도 영향을 주었죠.
하지만 여호와께 끊임없이 기도하고 성경 원칙을 적용한 덕분에
지금 저희 결혼 생활과 가족의 상태는 더할 나위 없이 좋아요.
영적 일과를 유지했고, 시련을 겪으면서도 가족 모두 전 시간 봉사를 놓지 않았죠.
우릴 도와 돈 버는 일을 하겠다고 했죠.
하지만 여호와께서 필요한 걸 더해 주실 거라고 확신하기 때문에
저희는 아이들이 왕국에 계속 초점을 맞추길 바래요.
남편은 영적 일과를 계속 확고히 유지하는 면에서
저희 모두에게 늘 좋은 본을 보였어요.
불평하거나 낙담해 있는 걸 본 적이 없어요.
그래서 가족 모두가 격려를 많이 받았죠.
4월 프로그램에 나온 대회 동영상 드라마 예고편을 보시고 분명 공감이 되셨겠군요.
오르티스 형제, 몸 상태에 대해 듣고 안타까웠습니다.
영적으로 계속 활발하고 강한 상태를 유지하는 데 도움이 된,
건강 문제를 극복할 힘을 얻기 위해 여호와께 끊임 없이 기도드렸습니다.
그리고 그 성구에선 그분이 우리에게 정신의 평화를 주실 거라고 말하죠.
우리 마음도 지켜 주실 거라고 했고요.
여호와께서 제게 바로 그렇게 해 주셨습니다.
이러한 말씀은 인생에서 겪는 어떤 상황에서도
그분이 계속 도와주실 거라는 위안을 줍니다.
또 아내가 돌보는 일이 정말 많다는 걸 잘 압니다.
거기 보면 훌륭한 아내가 가족을 위해 맡고 있는 책임들이 나오는데,
모리스 형제, 이건 바로 저희 자매 얘깁니다!
두 분이 서로를 얼마나 사랑하고 존중하는지 분명히 알겠네요.
또 부모로서 최선을 다해 온 두 분의 노력이
이 프로그램을 시청하는 부모들에게 좋은 본이 될 겁니다.
자 그럼, 두 분에겐 말씀을 드리지 않았지만,
두 아들을 초대해서 자랄 때 기억나는 일들을 들어 보죠.
엄마는 벌써 눈시울이 붉어지네요. 많이 놀라셨죠?
모든 집회에 빠지지 않고 참석했던 거랑 토요일마다 봉사에 나갔던 기억이 나요.
푸에르토리코에선 아버지가 일을 많이 해야 하셔서,
말씀하셨듯이 가족 숭배를 정기적으로 하는 게 쉽진 않았던 것 같아요.
하지만 이곳 미국으로 이사를 온 뒤로는
그러니까 가족간에도 점점 더 가까워지게 된 것 같습니다.
잘 됐네요. 에이드리언도 할 말이 있을 텐데요?
어머니와 아버지는 여호와께뿐 아니라 서로 간에도 항상 큰 사랑을 보이셨어요.
아이들이라도 그런 건 느낄 수 있죠.
사랑과 존중심이 어떤 건지 배울 수 있었어요.
형과 전 지금도 서로 사이가 아주 좋아요.
서로를 사랑하고 서로 간에 숨기는 게 없죠.
다 부모님이 보여 주신 사랑과 존중심 덕분이에요.
서로 의견이 다를 때도 있죠. 불완전한 가족이니까요.
하지만 항상 사랑으로 그런 차이들을 메꾸곤 해요.
한 가지 더 말하면, 제가 학교에 가기 전에
항상 아버지와 했던 게 있는데 그게 큰 도움이 됐어요.
여호와께서 절 사랑하신다는 걸 기억하고 행동하라고 늘 말씀하셨죠.
그게 얼마나 도움이 됐는지 아버진 잘 모르실 거예요.
열네 살밖에 안 되었을 때 정규 파이오니아를 시작하게 된 계기가 무엇인가요?
아버진 그 문제에만 매달려 고민하지 않고 영적인 관점으로 사물을 보셨죠.
저랑 스케줄이 딱 맞길래, 제가 아버지의 파이오니아 짝이 되기로 했죠.
느낀 게 있는데 영적인 가족이 영적인 일에 집중하면
서로 간의 존중심과 가족 사이가 이렇게 좋았던 때는 없는 거 같습니다.
에이드리언도 열네 살 때 파이오니아를 시작했죠?
파이오니아를 한 게 어떤 영향을 줬나요?
가족이 다 파이오니아였고, 늘 같이 봉사에 나가다 보니
저도 파이오니아 시간을 거의 다 하고 있더라고요.
하지만 매달 봉사에 70시간 이상을 바치는 책임을 받아들이니까
열네 살짜리 청소년으로선 하기 어려운 생각을 하게 되는 것 같아요.
회중에서 잠재력을 온전히 발휘하는 데 도움이 됐어요.
아버지가 심각한 건강 문제가 있어서 가족을 예전처럼 부양할 수 없을 거란 걸 알게 되었을 때
지금까지 겪은 일 중에 가장 힘들었던 것 같아요.
아버지가 암 진단을 받았을 때 즈음에 전 베델에 초대를 받았어요.
이렇게 가족이 힘든 때 집을 떠나 베델에 가는 건
하지만 저희 가족은 늘 영적인 관점으로 사물을 보았고
덕분에 가족 전체가 왕국 권익을 첫째로 두면
사랑 많은 아버지이신 여호와께서 부양해 주실 거란 걸 깨닫게 되었죠.
후에 아버지가 직업을 잃었을 때, 전 또 똑같은 고민을 했지만
회중이 당분간 돌봐 줄 거고 그 다음엔
어떻게든 생활을 더 단순하게 하면 된다고 말해 주셨죠.
자기에게 속한 사람들을 돌봐야 한다고 알려 주는 성구가 있죠.
저도 가족을 돕기 위해 할 수 있는 일을 다할 거예요.
제가 가장 바라는 건 가족이 힘든 시기를 겪으면서도 나타낸 훌륭한 믿음을
시청자 분들도 여러분이 말씀해 주신 점들에 모두 공감하셨을 거라 생각합니다.
저도 아버지로서 오르티스 형제가 기울인 노력에 감동을 받았습니다.
여러분 가정이 영적으로 번영하고 있는 걸 볼 수 있었고요,
앞으로도 여호와께서 계속 여러분의 노력을 축복하시길 기도합니다.
게이브리얼과 에이드리언도 깜짝 출연해 줘서 고마웠어요.
시간 내서 함께 해 주셔서 정말 감사합니다.

en.text: We’ve now invited
Brother and Sister Ortiz from New Britain, Connecticut,
to visit our studio.
Brother Ortiz serves as an elder and as a regular pioneer.
He’s had many additional privileges of service over the years.
And Linnette has been regular pioneering for over six years.
However, the reason we wanted to talk with them is that thus far
they have successfully countered Satan’s attacks on their family.
We’d like to hear how they accomplished this.
First of all, Freddie,
tell us a little bit about your family.
Neither Linnette nor I were raised in the truth.
However, we met, and we fell in love.
At that time, marriage was not for me.
So we started a romantic relationship for two years
before we started attending the first meeting at the Kingdom Hall.
Soon thereafter, we started studying the Bible;
and we took two studies per week; we knew this was the truth.
But also we learned
how Jehovah sees immorality, so we needed to do some changes.
Linnette’s parents wanted her to continue
with her education, so we needed to change our behavior.
So two years after,
we did the changes.
Number one because we did love Jehovah.
Number two because we loved what we were learning.
It was worth it to follow Bible principles.
So two years later, we got married
and we got baptized —and we got married.
Very good.
So, Linnette, you were raised without a knowledge of Jehovah God.
What changes did you both have to make to ensure
your own family would have a fine foundation
and be successful?
Well, prior to our baptism, Freddie had a serious drinking problem.
And based on the way we were raised, there was a lot of jealousy going on
and, I would say, a lack of confidence and trust in each other.
My Bible teacher, thankfully, suggested to us
to study the book Making Your Family Life Happy.
And we ended up studying that book twice.
That publication and the Bible principles in it became the foundation
of our wonderful marriage and the happy family we enjoy today.
Very nice.
So, Freddie, maybe you can tell us about your children
and what they are doing with their lives now.
We have two sons.
Gabriel, he’s the oldest one.
He started regular pioneering when he was 14 years old.
At 18, he was appointed as a ministerial servant.
At 22 years old, he has been working in the Plumbing Department
at the Warwick construction for more than two years.
Adrian is now 18 years old.
And he also started regular pioneering when he was 14.
Currently, he handles the accounts for the congregation
and other privileges as well.
Well, they both have had an early start in their theocratic careers.
That’s commendable.
I’m sure you’re both proud of them.
And we’re confident that Jehovah,
the One “to whom every family . . . owes its name,”
is pleased that they are giving an answer to his taunter.
In addition to the Family Life book,
what else contributed to the success your family
has experienced, Linnette?
The Governing Body has provided us with so many publications
with direction for families, of course, all based on Jehovah’s Word.
So we decided early on that whenever a question or an issue came up,
we would not make any decision based on impulse.
Instead, we would research it in the publications.
We pray to Jehovah for him to give us wisdom.
And we even pray for him to guide us
to find the right time to talk to each other or to counsel the boys.
I have always heard that there are stages
in the child’s life and personality development.
So I researched in advance as to what to expect.
In that way, we were not surprised
when we saw changes in attitudes or ideas.
And that helped us realize what needed
to be addressed or corrected as opposed to what was normal
for that stage in the boys’ lives.
Very practical.
Freddie, what can you add?
Over the years, I have learned how essential it is to become a good listener
—also understanding.
I tell my family how much I love them every day
because we never know when circumstances might change.
Family worship is very important for us.
I know it is easy to put off, but the benefits are hard to beat.
Well, before this arrangement started,
we as a family, we valued the Bible study with the family.
I learned that a fetus that is six months,
he can recognize the family’s voice.
So I started a Bible study with my sons when they were still in the womb . . .
Isn’t that nice.
. . . and continued to do so after that.
I know that secular work and other activities
can block a regular program,
but we need to fight that tendency if we want to succeed in family worship.
Very good.
Well, it seems your efforts paid off when we consider
how well your family has done spiritually
and the close relationship you have with each other.
Now Linnette, it sounds as if the family is perfect
—no challenges.
Is that the case?
No, not at all.
First Corinthians 10:13 says that Christians will face
challenges that are “common to [all] men.”
And we have faced the normal challenges that come with raising a family.
The same verse indicates
that if we do things Jehovah’s way,
we may increase the opportunity for him to “make the way out” for us.
One unexpected challenge
that has changed our family dynamics
over the years now, was when Freddie
was diagnosed with cancer in 2012.
The treatment was aggressive and took its toll on his health.
Our whole lifestyle changed.
We had to move out from our house . . .
Oh, boy.
. . . to an apartment,
we gave away our dog, Spike,
and we have to watch our expenses really closely to keep going.
This could have put a lot of strain in our family,
in our marriage, and in our spirituality.
But, again, by praying to Jehovah constantly and applying Bible principles,
I can say my marriage
and my family have never been better.
Wow.
Spiritually, we kept our routine, and we all stayed
in full-time service throughout the ordeal.
The boys have cooperated very well.
They have offered to work to give us money.
But we prefer for them to keep focused on the Kingdom
because we are confident that Jehovah
will add on to the things we need.
Freddie has been a great example for all of us
because he pushes himself
to keep his spiritual routine.
You never see him complaining or in a bad mood.
And that has been very inspiring for the rest of the family.
Boy, that is quite a story.
You folks will certainly relate to the convention drama video
that was advertised on our April program.
Freddie, we’re very sorry to hear about your physical condition.
Are there any favorite scriptures that you use
to help keep you going spiritually and to stay strong?
There are many of them.
Just to mention a few, Philippians 4:6,7
has been my life since 2012,
where I have to pray to Jehovah constantly
so that he can give me the strength that I need
to overcome my health.
And also, Philippians says
that he will give us peace of mind.
In addition, he will safeguard our heart.
And that’s something I’ve been seeing from Jehovah.
Also, Isaiah 41:10 states:
“Do not be anxious, for I am your God.”
Those words give me comfort that he will keep on helping us
in these different circumstances in our life.
I do understand that my wife has a lot of responsibilities in the household,
so I had to reread Proverbs 31
verses 10 to 31,
where it describes all of the responsibility a good wife
might have to shoulder for the family.
So Brother Morris, she is my Proverbs 31 wife!
A good wife for sure.
You’ve obviously shown how much you love and respect each other.
That’s commendable.
And your focus on being the best parents you could be is a good example
for parents viewing the program at this time.
This will come as a surprise to you,
but we would like to invite your two sons out to see what they remember
from growing up in the family.
We have Gabriel and Adrian with us.
Mom’s getting a little teary-eyed.
That’s understandable. It was a surprise, see.
So Gabriel, since you’re the oldest,
we will start with you.
What do you remember about your family life,
first in Puerto Rico and later here in the United States?
I remember faithfully going to all the meetings and going out in service
every Saturday —that was just the routine.
In Puerto Rico, my dad had to work a lot though,
and like he said before, that’s easy to get in the way
of a good family worship routine.
But I can honestly say that once we made that transition of moving over here,
that helped us to have a good family worship routine,
and it has helped us to get closer and closer each day.
Now, isn’t that nice?
Now, Adrian, anything you can add about the homelife?
Yeah, my mom and dad have always
shown a great love for Jehovah but also for each other.
So as kids, you could just sense that.
So love and respect is what we’ve always known.
Even now that my brother and I are older, we have a great bond with each other.
We love each other and we can tell each other everything about our lives.
And it’s due to that love and respect that they have shown.
And even if there are disagreements,
which there are always going to be disagreements
because it’s an imperfect family,
but that love is always there to bridge those differences.
I also would like to add, something that helped me a lot
was a routine that my dad and I had
right before going to school; we would always read the daily text.
And he would always say, “Behave, and remember that Jehovah loves you.”
I don’t think he knows how much that really helped me
go through everyday challenges at school.
That’s priceless.
Now, very nice observations.
Gabriel, I’m interested in understanding what prompted you
to regular pioneer when you were only 14 years old?
It was at a point where my dad lost his job.
Rather than stressing about it —worrying about it
—he looked at things with a spiritual perspective.
So he started to pioneer.
And since our schedules matched perfectly,
I was his little pioneer buddy.
I would go out in service with him whenever he needed it.
And I feel like if spiritual families, you know, focus on spiritual matters,
it helps them to become closer.
And I can’t imagine how our relationship
and respect for one another can be any better than what it is now.
Very nice.
Now, Adrian, you began pioneering
when you were 14 as well.
How do you think that affected you as a person?
Well, first of all, the reason why I started pioneering
was because I was going out in service with the rest of my family,
and since they were already pioneering, I was getting the time in.
But I do think that taking on the responsibility
of getting at least 70 hours a month
in the service does make you think differently
at 14 than it would have otherwise.
I think it has helped me mature spiritually,
and it has contributed to me being used to my full potential in the congregation.
And honestly, I wouldn’t trade it for anything, well, maybe going to Bethel.
Gabriel, back to you.
Tell us what was it like when you learned
that your dad had a serious health problem
and would not be able to provide for the family like he used to?
That was probably one of the biggest challenges I have ever faced.
When my dad got diagnosed with cancer, it was about the same time
that I got my call to Bethel.
And I was torn; I was divided.
I felt like if I was to go to Bethel now,
it would be selfish of me to leave my family at a time like that.
But my family always had a spiritual view
on things and cited scriptures like Matthew 6:33 constantly.
It helped me to see as a whole—as a family —we put Kingdom interests first;
that Jehovah was going to provide
because he’s a loving father and friend.
And then my dad lost his job, and again all these feelings came up.
But my family was adamant.
They let me know that the congregation had been taking care of them
for months now, and then doing some simplifying
on their own helped them as well.
And I didn’t have to worry about anything.
I do know that there’s a scripture that says that we’ve got to take care of our own.
So I do anything I can to help my family back home.
The only thing I hope is that I can have a good faith
like they’ve shown through these difficult times.
Well, thank all of you for joining us.
I think all of us are feeling that emotion
and feel very close to you for sharing that.
Now, as a father, I can appreciate all that Freddie is trying to do
as head of the family.
And, Linnette, your support beyond normal
is very much to be commended.
We can tell your family is thriving spiritually,
and we pray Jehovah will continue to bless your efforts,
come what may.
And we thank you, Gabriel and Adrian,
for your surprise to the studio.
Thank you very much for taking the time to be interviewed.
Thank you for the privilege.
Thank you for the privilege.
Thank you.

en.text: We’re also pleased to announce the release of a new brochure
entitled Answers to 10 Questions Young People Ask.
The content of this 32-page, full-color brochure
is based on articles in Awake! and the two volumes
of Questions Young People Ask —Answers That Work, as well as
the “Young People Ask” articles on the jw.org website.
This new brochure will be particularly helpful
to those who speak a language in which that material is not available.
However, all young people can benefit from this new brochure
because the original articles have been updated and rewritten.
Each section of the brochure addresses one question.
After stating the question, the section begins with a pointed statement
under the feature “Why It Matters,”
letting the reader know why that question is relevant.
Then, a “What Would You Do?” scenario is presented,
putting the reader in a hypothetical situation
related to the topic.
After discussing various principles,
Scriptural advice directs the reader to the best answers
for that particular question.
The 10 Questions brochure is interactive,
allowing the reader to write responses
to the various questions presented.
The final topic, “How Can the Bible Help Me?,”
is designed to invite readers who are not Jehovah’s Witnesses
to accept a Bible study.
The brochure makes numerous references
to the jw.org website
and directs readers to more information that can be found there.
Also, the brochure is designed in such a way
that young people can be comfortable sharing it with their peers
and with others in the ministry.
This brochure is already approved for translation
into 324 languages.
Of these languages, 223 do not produce Awake!
and 262 have not produced
the Young People Ask books.
So we expect that Answers to 10 Questions Young People Ask
will help many more youths benefit
from the Bible’s practical wisdom.
Following this program, digital formats of the brochure
will become available on the jw.org website,
the JW Library app, and on Watchtower ONLINE LIBRARY
as they are produced in each language.
Additionally, printed copies of the brochure can be requested
through your congregation at the conclusion of this program.

titles.en: New Release: Answers to 10 Questions Young People Ask

title: 결혼 준비—1부: 나는 데이트할 준비가 되어 있나?

ko.text: 살면서 다른 변화를 겪을 때에도 도움이 되죠.
십 대 청소년이라면 아마 점점 이성에 눈을 뜨게 될 수 있습니다.
하지만 아직 결혼하기엔 이르다면 무엇을 기억하는 게 좋을까요?
한 청소년 자매가 부모님의 도움을 받아 어떻게 지혜로운 결정을 내리는지 보시죠.
제 이름은 릴리인데, 문제가 좀 있었어요.
증인이 아닌 사람을 좋아하면 안 된다는 건 알아요.
숀의 가족이 우리 회중으로 이사 왔어요.
그런데 보면 볼수록 더 좋아지는 거예요.
“내 한숨 때문에 내 힘이 다 빠졌구나.
하느님을 어디에서 찾을 수 있는지 알 수만 있다면!
제 또래가 이성 친구와 다니는 걸 학교에서 매일 보는데,
솔직히, 저도 그런 행복을 맛보고 싶었어요.

나도 니 나이였을 때 똑같이 느꼈던 기억이 있어.

무엇보다도, 서둘지 않고 잘 들어 주셨죠.
아빠도 제 문제를 도와주려고 준비하고 계셨죠.

멋진 연기를 쉽게 하는 것처럼 보일 수 있지만, 정말 그럴까?
많은 연습과 유능한 파트너와 올바른 지도가 없다면,
아무도 흉내조차 내지 못할 걸. 그렇지?
좋은 파트너를 만나서 같이 노력해야 되지.

네게서 눈을 떼지 않고 충고를 베풀겠다.”

en.text: Having a spiritually strong family
prepares us also for other changes in life.
Perhaps you are in your teens
and you’re starting to notice those of the opposite sex.
Such emotions are natural and are part of growing up.
But if you’re not old enough to get married,
what do you need to keep in mind?
This young sister made wise decisions
with the loving help of her parents.
Uhh, yours?
Yeah. Thanks.
You’re Lily, right?
Yeah. And you’re Sean.
Yeah. I’ve seen you around.
You play good basketball.
Thanks. So do you.
So you want to hang out sometime?
Sure.
My name is Lily, and I sorta had this problem.
There’s a boy named Sean that recently moved to our school.
I know I’m not supposed to like anyone who is not a Witness.
The trouble was,
he is  a Witness.
Sean and his family moved into our congregation.
And the more I saw of him,
the more I liked him.
If only I knew where to find God!
Like I said, “I had a problem.”
Every day I see couples my age at school.
To me, they look happy.
Honestly, I wanted that happiness too.
My parents noticed my problem too
and talked about it that night.
And pretty soon
I didn’t feel alone anymore.
The next day,
my mom invited me to go with her to run an errand.
Afterward, we went to a little café.
She asked me how things were going.
At first, I didn’t want to tell her,
but she made me feel really comfortable.
So I told her my feelings for Sean,
expecting her to think bad of me.
But she didn’t.
Everything you’re feeling is natural, Lily.
I remember having these same feelings when I was your age too.
Really?
It’s true.
That’s just how Jehovah created us, Honey.
And because he created us, he knows
the best way for us to be happy.
And that’s all he wants for us.
And that’s all Daddy and I want for you too.
She didn’t scold me; she didn’t make me feel embarrassed.
And most importantly, she didn’t seem to be in a rush.
My mom wasn’t the only one helping me.
My dad was preparing to help me with my problem too.
That evening, we had family worship.
And once again,
they just let me talk.
They told me I didn’t have to hold back, so I didn’t.
I just don’t know what to do.
Lily, thank you for telling us how you feel.
Let me ask you something:
Why do you think Jehovah created us with these
natural feelings toward the opposite sex?
So that one day a man and woman could marry.
That’s right!
In fact, a good marriage
is like two skaters on the ice.
A beautiful performance
can seem effortless, but is it really?
No.
No one would even attempt that without practice,
a capable partner, or the right kind of guidance.
Right?
Yeah.
Well, it’s the same with a good marriage, Sweetie.
It doesn’t just happen.
It too depends on a good partner,
coordinated effort, but most importantly,
wise counsel from Jehovah.
In fact, could you please turn with me
to Psalm 32:8 and read that for us.
Sure.
It says:
“I will give you insight and instruct you in the way you should go.
I will give you advice with my eye upon you.”
Lily, Jehovah loves us very much.
And if we listen to him, we’ll make good decisions in our life
with absolutely no regrets.
We talked some more, and then I got some homework.
My dad gave me some articles he printed out for me to read,
so I did.
And as I read the words
and started meditating on them,
I realized something.
By holding off dating a little longer, I wasn’t missing out.
Rather, I was preparing myself.
I could use the time now to focus
on something much more important
—my relationship with Jehovah.
I could also gain Christian qualities
and experience that will help me later
if I ever do get married.

title: 이사를 할 때에도 영적으로 중심을 잃지 마십시오

ko.text: 가족의 보금자리였고 예쁜 두 딸을 여기서 키웠죠.
이 일이 있었기에 가족을 부양할 수 있었죠.
저희 가족은 이 문제에 대해 많이 기도하고
그동안 우리 가족은 이 집과 회중을 떠나본 적이 없거든요.
딸들에겐 이 회중에 좋은 본이 되고
여호와를 섬기도록 잘 도와주는 친구들이 많아요.
몇 년 전에 우리 회중으로 이사를 온 형제가 있는데,
그때 가족이 어떻게 어려움에 대처했는지 물어봤어요.
무엇보다 영적 일과를 변함없이 유지하는 게 중요하다고 말해 줬습니다.
집회와 봉사에 빠지지 않고, 형제 자매들과 시간을 보내고,
조사를 좀 해 보니 우리 상황에 잘 적용되는 성구가 있었습니다.
바람이 불어 그 집에 몰아쳤으나 집은 무너지지 않았습니다.
이 슬기로운 사람은 튼튼한 기초 위에 집을 지었어요.
영적으로 중심을 잃지 않게 계획을 잘 세워야 했죠.
슬기로운 사람이 그랬던 것처럼 튼튼한 영적 기초를 놓고 싶었죠.
그래서 이사 전에 새 회중에 미리 가 보았어요.
다니던 왕국회관과 회중 사람들에 아주 익숙해졌죠.
다른 사람들도 우리를 도로 헤아려 줄 것’이라고 말하죠.
새 회중과 친숙해지는 가장 좋은 방법은
회중 형제 자매들과 함께 봉사하는 거예요.
어느 곳에 가든지 우리는 여호와와 서로를 사랑하는 동료들을 찾을 수 있죠.
짐을 다 싣고, 마지막으로 문을 잠그고 집을 나섰습니다.
노력이 들긴 했지만, 새 회중에 미리 찾아가 본 건 참 잘한 일이었습니다.
하지만 가족 숭배 때 우리 모두 약속한 게 있었는데,
이사 때문에 영적 일과에 지장이 생기지는 않게 하자는 거였죠.
우린 아무것도 집회에 가는 데 방해가 되지 않게 미리 계획했습니다.
적응하면서 새로운 봉사 기술을 배워야 했죠.
영적인 필요에 민감하게 반응하는 게 특히 중요해요.
절대 가족 숭배를 거르면 안 되죠.
큰 변화가 있을 때 영적으로 중심을 유지하는 게 쉽진 않습니다.
영적인 필요뿐 아니라 감정적인 필요까지 돌보기 위해
가족이 영적으로 중심을 유지하는 데 큰 도움이 됐습니다.

en.text: For 23 years, we’ve called this place home.
We’ve raised a family here
—two beautiful girls.
Six months ago, my boss called me into his office.
The company was restructuring.
They valued my work, but if I wanted to keep my job,
I would need to move.
It was a difficult decision.
My job allowed me to support my family well, and it had never interfered
with our spiritual routine.
We said many prayers about it.
We discussed it as a family, and we decided to move.
But we were anxious.
My family has only ever known one home, one congregation.
My girls have many friends in the congregation,
good examples who are helping them to serve Jehovah.
This is going to be hard on all of us.
A brother in our hall had moved into the congregation a few years ago.
I asked him how his family coped with the challenge.
He said that the key to staying grounded is maintaining the one thing
that should never change —our spiritual routine.
But that requires work and planning
to make sure our move doesn’t stop us from getting to the meetings,
sharing in the ministry, spending time
with our brothers and sisters, and looking after our family.
His advice was spot-on.
After some research, I found a scripture that illustrated our situation.
“And the rain poured down and the floods came
“and the winds blew and lashed against that house, but it did not cave in,
for it had been founded on the rock.”
The discreet man built his house on good foundations.
It took a plan, and he worked hard.
When the storm came, his house survived.
As a family,
we needed a plan that would help us stay spiritually grounded through our move.
So we wrote our own plan.
Just like the discreet man,
we wanted to build our move on a strong spiritual foundation.
So we made a visit to our new congregation ahead of our move.
Over the years, it becomes a comfort
to walk into a Kingdom Hall and see familiar faces.
Walking into our new congregation reminded me
how much we are going to miss everyone.
But the Bible tells us that ‘with the measure we measure out,
others will measure to us in return.’
So we resolved to show love first.
Hello, I’m Jessica.
Hi, I’m Samantha. Nice to meet you.
The best way to get to know our new congregation is to work
with the brothers and sisters in the ministry.
No matter where we go, we’ll find people
that love Jehovah and each other.
Moving day finally arrived.
The last boxes were packed.
We locked the door one final time and began our journey to our new home.
It took effort,
but visiting the congregation ahead of time
was well worth it.
Look! We already have friends here.
Unpacking seemed to never end,
but the one thing that we all promised ourselves
at family worship was that we would not let
our move affect our spiritual routine.
Has anyone seen my ties?
Found them!
We planned that we wouldn’t let anything stop us
from going to the meetings.
The ministry is very different.
We’ve had to adapt and learn new techniques.
The brothers and sisters are different too.
It’s important not to focus
on negative comparisons.
Instead, be positive.
During this transition, it is especially important to be sensitive
to our spiritual needs.
Family worship is vital.
Keeping spiritually grounded through such a big transition isn’t easy,
especially with a family.
It took a lot of time and energy to care for our needs,
not just spiritually, but emotionally too.
Planning ahead, like the discreet man,
helped our family to stay spiritually grounded.

title: 가족 숭배: 노아—하느님과 함께 걸은 사람

ko.text: 가족의 영적 건강을 튼튼하게 지키는 중요한 한가지 방법은
가족 숭배 마련을 온전히 활용하는 것입니다.
다음 동영상에서 가장이 어떻게 가족 성원 각자의 필요를 이해하고
몇 주 전에 가족이 함께 앉아 저녁을 먹고 있었습니다.
전 몹시 피곤했고 아내 제니도 마찬가지였죠.
아내는 항상 아이들을 아주 잘 돌보는데,
세라는 옷차림에 대해 우리가 너무 엄격하다고 생각했고,
그리고 세라를 야외 봉사에 데리고 나가기가 점점 힘이 듭니다.
늘 이랬던 건 아닌데, 전에는 봉사 나가는 걸 좋아했거든요.
그런데 갑자기, 학교 친구 휴대폰에 있는 게임에 정신이 팔렸습니다.
늘 초능력을 쓰는 내용의 게임인데 거기에 홀딱 빠졌죠,
쓰레기 좀 버리라고 하면, 힘들다고 해요.
잠 자러 가거나 자기 방 치우는 걸 싫어했죠.
말해 줘야 할 게 몇 가지 있다는 걸 깨달았습니다.
그날 저녁, 남편과 함께 아이들 이야기를 많이 했어요.
함께 기도했고, 그러자 좋은 생각이 떠올랐어요!
다음 날, 아이들에게 가족 숭배 때 노아를 주제로 하면 어떻겠냐고 물었죠.
저는 마이크와 톰과 함께 방주를 만들기로 했죠.
그리고 세라는 우리 출판물에서 그 내용에 관한 삽화를 수집했어요.
또 저는 시간을 내서, 노아 이야기가
우리 가족에게 어떻게 도움이 될지 다시 생각해 봤죠.
준비를 하면서, 좀 더 느긋한 분위기에서
옷에 관해 세라와 대화할 시간을 가졌어요.
노아와 그 가족이 어떤 세상에서 살았는지 이야기했죠.
노아의 가족이 전파하는 데는 진정한 용기가 필요했어요.
그런 일은 일어난 적이 한 번도 없었거든요.
최근에 세라가 봉사하다가 학교 친구를 만나서
그래서 노아는 여호와를 친구로서 굳게 신뢰할 수 있었죠.
아빠는 그 당시 세상이 아주 악했다고 하셨어요.
늘 싸움이 벌어져서 겁에 질린 사람이 많았기 때문에,
학교 친구들이 하는 게임을 생각해 봤어요.
‘그리고 모든 부류의 생물을 두 마리씩 방주 안으로 데리고 들어가라.’
아빠가 동물들이 어떻게 방주로 들어갔는지 보여 줬어요.
다 자기 자리가 있어서, 엉망이 되지 않고 두 마리씩 들어갔어요.
그 방주처럼 우리의 방도 깨끗이 정리해야 한다고 설명해 주었죠.
우리 가족은 창세기 6:22의 말씀을 마음에 새기고 싶었습니다.
그다음엔 비가 왔지만, 우리 가족은 다 살아남았어요!
노아도 틀림없이 피곤할 때가 있었을 텐데
결코 포기하지 않았다는 걸 우리 모두 배웠어요.
우리는 노아처럼 가족을 잘 돌봐야 하죠.
그러려면 이런 가족 숭배를 정기적으로 해야 합니다.
가족 숭배가 얼마나 유익한 점이 많은지 잘 보여 주지 않습니까?
함께 모여 하늘의 아버지에 대해 더 많이 배울 수 있다는 분명한 사실 외에도
우린 동영상에서 어떻게 가족 숭배를 통해
딸이 마음을 열고 고민거리를 털어 놓는지 보았습니다.
자녀들은 각자 생활에 적용할 수 있는 점을 배울 수 있었죠.

en.text: An important aspect
of keeping the family’s spiritual health intact
is by making full use of the Family Worship arrangement.
In this dramatization, pay attention
to how the family head is aware of the needs of the family
and how he plans accordingly.
Hi, my name is Joe.
A few weeks ago, we all sat together for supper.
I was so tired, and my wife, Jenny, felt the same way.
She always does it all, taking care of the children so well,
but it was not easy for her in recent weeks.
Sarah felt that we are too restrictive on how she dresses.
She just does not understand.
It was hard to convince her.
And to motivate her to share in the field service
is becoming a challenge.
It was not always like this.
She used to enjoy going out in field service.
And Tom, he is such a good boy,
but all of a sudden, he was raving about the games
his classmates have on their phones.
It’s always about having supernatural powers,
and it fascinated him, even though he is small.
But when I asked him to take out the garbage,
suddenly his superpowers left him.
And Mike,
our smallest,
it was hard to get him to go to bed
or clean up his room.
I realized there are a few things we need to speak about.
Joe came to me, and we talked a lot about our children that same evening.
We wondered, ‘What would be the best for them?’
We prayed together.
Then we had an idea!
The following day we asked our children
if we could consider Noah as the theme for our next family worship.
All of us liked the idea.
Each one of us should prepare something.
Mike, Tom, and I wanted to build the ark.
And, of course, we need the animals.
And Sarah should collect pictures
for the story from our publications.
I also had to take time to think again about the story of Noah
and how it can help our family.
Jenny and Sarah were responsible for the wardrobe and food.
While preparing, I got the chance
to speak with Sarah about her dress in a more relaxed setting.
She understood that, like Noah,
when it comes to Jehovah’s commands, we need to do “just so.”
Then the evening arrived.
We talked about how it was before the Flood
and what kind of world Noah and his family lived in.
Noah’s family needed real courage to preach.
They had to explain about the rain and how the ark would be needed
to survive the Flood —something that had never happened before.
All the people thought they were crazy!
And while we were talking about this, it came out
that Sarah felt embarrassed when she met a schoolmate in the field service recently.
I realized Noah must have felt the same as me,
and yet, he was so courageous.
Dad read Genesis 6:9:
“Noah walked with the true God.”
So he could have every confidence in his Friend, Jehovah.
I want to be just like that!
For Tom, I found a great picture.
Dad told us that the world at this time was very bad.
People were fighting and many were afraid,
and that is why Jehovah brought the Flood.
It made me think about the games from my schoolmates.
I like to play those games, but I know that Jehovah does not like that.
So why do I?
And the best part was when we got inside the ark!
Then I read Genesis 6:19:
“And bring into the ark
two of every sort of living creature.”
Dad showed us how the animals went into the ark.
Each one had its own place,
and they went inside two at a time without any chaos.
I explained that we also need to keep our rooms clean like the ark.
I saw that Mike got the point.
We wanted to keep in mind Genesis 6:22:
“And Noah did according to all that God had commanded him.
He did just so.”
And then the rain came, but we survived!
That was great!
We all realized
Noah also must have been tired sometimes,
but he never gave up.
This was a good lesson for us.
We must take care of our family as Noah did,
also by having a regular family worship
like this.
That example really showed
many of the great benefits of family worship.
In addition to the obvious
—coming together to learn more about our heavenly Father
—we saw how family worship gave the daughter
an opportunity to open up about matters
that had been bothering her.
And thanks to the good work of the parents,
all of the children learned something
they could apply in their daily lives.

en.text: I would first like to read to you some passages from the Bible
found at Ephesians chapter 3,
verses 14 through 19.
This will also establish the theme for my comments this month.
Ephesians 3, starting with verse 14, Paul said:
“For this reason I bend my knees to the Father,
“to whom every family in heaven and on earth owes its name.
“I pray that he may grant you through the abundance of his glory
“to be made mighty in the man you are inside,
“with power through his spirit,
“and that through your faith you may have the Christ dwell in your hearts with love.
“May you be rooted and established on the foundation,
“in order that with all the holy ones you may be thoroughly able
“to comprehend fully what is the breadth
“and length and height and depth,
“and to know the love of the Christ, which surpasses knowledge,
“so that you may be filled with all the fullness
that God gives.”
Now, verse 15
is the inspiration for my theme, namely,
“Glorify Jehovah—The One to Whom Every Family Owes Its Name.”
The family unit is under a vicious attack in these last days.
The Insight book lived up to its name
under the heading “Family.”
The very insightful comment reads this way:
“The inspired Scriptures have foretold a vicious attack
“on the family institution with a consequent breaking down of morality
and of human society outside the . . . congregation.”
The article pointed out that in “‘the last days’
“a condition in which disobedience to parents,
“disloyalty, and absence of ‘natural affection’ would be rife,
even among those ‘having a form of godly devotion.’”
How can married couples, parents, and children
counteract such a diabolical attack?
Do you remember those verses we read in Ephesians chapter 3?
Verse 16 said that the One to whom every family owes its name,
Jehovah, would ‘grant us to be made mighty
in the person we are inside.’
Yes, Jehovah can give us
the internal spiritual strength to fight back
against Satan’s efforts to destroy the family.
How?
By being immersed in God’s Word.
In particular, by imitating the loving way
that Jesus treated his disciples.
Did you note that Ephesians 3:17 said
we are to “have the Christ dwell in [our] hearts with love”?
Yes, if each of us cherishes the Christ in our hearts
to the point that he dwells, or resides, there constantly,
our family will not only survive
but it will truly thrive.
This will be so evident that verse 17 further states
that we will “be rooted and established on the foundation.”
We will be solid!
And keep in mind that 1 Corinthians 3:11 says
that the “foundation” on which we build
“is Jesus Christ.”
Then verse 18 of Ephesians chapter 3 indicates that
our spiritual peripheral vision will be enhanced.
We will not have spiritual blind spots
that could allow the spirit of the world to creep into the family.
That verse says that we will “be thoroughly able
“to comprehend fully what is the breadth
and length and height and depth.”
All aspects of Jesus’ personality will come into play
as we interact with family members.
Finally, verse 19 sums up the result when it says
that we would then have come “to know the love of the Christ,
which surpasses knowledge.”
Granted, knowledge is important,
but it is the application
of Christlike love that will preserve our family,
keeping it vibrantly intact.
Family life in these critical last days
could be likened to those who suffer from diabetes.
It is believed that diabetes is caused
by both genetic and environmental factors.
Similarly, all in the family have inherited sin
and imperfection from our first human parents,
Adam and Eve, as if genetically.
However, we are also exposed to the ever more toxic
environmental factors of Satan’s evil world.
Most who suffer from a serious case of diabetes
need to use two methods
to successfully relieve the symptoms and lead a normal life.
They have to watch their diet and, in many cases,
take an injection of insulin daily.
Spiritually, we need to avoid the sickly,
sweet junk food that the world promotes in movies,
talk shows, the Internet, and in print.
Just as with the person who has diabetes,
this requires a permanent lifestyle change
from what we might have exposed ourselves to in the past.
In addition to avoiding
unwholesome junk food from Satan’s system,
we also need to take daily “injections”
of God’s Word and other wholesome provisions.
This has become more and more important
the deeper we get into these last days.
How has our organization provided this when it comes to family life?
Well, in the early 1900’s,
the focus was on preaching the good news.
Little attention was given
to building strong Christian marriages and families.
For a time, marriage was even discouraged
well beyond the intent of the Scriptures.
I did some checking, and commendably
between 1919 and 1921
there was a feature in the Golden Age magazine
once or twice a month called the “Juvenile Bible Study.”
In 1920, a brochure was released
called The Golden Age ABC.
Then it wasn’t until 1941 that the now famous book
entitled Children was handed out
to all young ones at the convention that year.
But as the last days progressed,
more and more information for families was produced.
For example, in the 1970’s,
the book Making Your Family Life Happy was released.
About the same time, the books Listening to the Great Teacher
and Your Youth—Getting the Best out of It were published.
In 1982, Awake! began a regular series
that has run for decades entitled “Young People Ask.”
We now have two up-to-date books with the same title,
and the series of articles continues on the jw.org website.
We have the book Learn From the Great Teacher
and so many features and activities for young ones
on the website that I would be out of time if I tried to enumerate them all.
There are also regular articles in our magazines
about marriage and family life.
And I will certainly never forget the privilege I had in 2012
to introduce the animated series Become Jehovah’s Friend.
That has proved to be a blessing
for both young ones and their parents.
What a teaching tool for both!
In 2014, I attended the international convention
in Atlanta, Georgia, here in the United States.
After a little two-year-old girl saw my face
on the big jumbo screen giving a talk,
she eagerly started searching all around her for someone.
When her parents asked her who she was looking for, she said, “Caleb.
He must be here because I saw his grandfather giving a talk.”
Many children ask
to meet Caleb in person when they visit Bethel.
Two postings of an item every month
is making quite an impression on little hearts.
With Bible principles being impressed on the minds and hearts
of children so early, we prayerfully anticipate
many spiritually-minded teenagers in the years to come.
We have so much healthy spiritual food
for counteracting family “diabetes.”
For this, we give all glory to Jehovah,
the one “to whom every family . . . owes its name.”
One of the favorite passages of Scripture that anyone
professing to be Christian loves is the 23rd Psalm.
Family heads, can we benefit
from imitating not only the Fine Shepherd, Jesus,
but also the Great Shepherd, Jehovah God?
I am going to borrow the text of the 23rd Psalm
and adjust the words so that we can sense a family’s tranquillity
when headship is exercised properly.
In fact, you husbands,
as the script is read, imagine it is your wife’s voice
describing the effect your headship has on your family.
‘[My husband] is [our] shepherd.
‘[We] will lack nothing.
‘In grassy pastures [refreshing recreation]
‘he makes [us] lie down; he leads [us]
‘to well-watered resting-places [meetings and conventions].
‘He refreshes [us].
‘He leads [us in the ministry]
‘in the paths of righteousness for the sake of [Jehovah’s] name.
‘Though [we] walk in the valley of deep [economic] shadow,
‘[we] fear no harm, for [Dad is] with [us];
‘your rod and your staff [loving discipline] reassure [us].
‘You prepare a table [of family worship, helping the children]
‘for [us] before [our] enemies.
‘You refresh [our] head[s] with oil;
‘[Our] cup [of family well-being] is well-filled.
‘Surely goodness and loyal love will pursue [our family]
‘all the days of [our] life, and [our family]
will dwell in the house of Jehovah for all [our] days.’
No further application called for.
We feel the sense of security that envelops
the interior rooms of such a home, don’t we?
Do you remember the point made
in Ephesians chapter 3, which we read earlier?
We are to treasure Jesus’ personality
and let it “dwell” in our hearts.
If all in the family make a determined effort
to treat each other like Jesus would,
we can conquer the world!
Yes, we—His spiritual family in heaven
and all humans on earth who dedicate their lives to Him
—give glory to Jehovah!
Indeed, we thank Jehovah
for all the spiritual provisions he has made through his Word
and organization to protect every family who takes up his name.
May Jehovah bless all of you families
as you strive to win the war that Satan wages
against you in these last days.

en.text: Look, Mom!
I drew our family in school today!
Oh, wow!
I didn’t have time to finish Caleb’s face.
Carrie drew two mommies.
She told me they’re married to each other.
My teacher says that all that matters
is that people love each other and that they’re happy.
Hmm.
Well, people have their own ideas about what is right and wrong,
but what matters is how Jehovah feels.
He wants us to be happy, and he knows how we can be happiest!
That’s why he invented marriage the way he did.
You mean one man and one woman?
Exactly! Look at Genesis 1:27.
Jehovah created Adam and Eve, male and female.
Then in Genesis 2:24 he said
that “a man will . . . stick to his wife.”
Later, Jesus said the same thing!
Jehovah’s standards haven’t changed.
It’s kind of like going on an airplane.
What would happen if someone wanted to bring
something on the plane that wasn’t allowed?
They couldn’t go on their trip!
Right! It’s the same with Jehovah.
He wants us to be his friend and live in Paradise forever!
But we have to follow his standards to get there.
At Matthew 7:13, 14 it talks about the road leading to Paradise.
To get there, Jehovah says we have to leave some things behind.
That means anything Jehovah doesn’t approve of.
But I want everyone to get to Paradise!
So does Jehovah! And you know what?
People can change!
That’s why we share his message.
So, what can you say to Carrie?
Well, I can tell her about the Paradise.
I can tell her about the animals and the resurrection!
That’s awesome! Let’s practice.

en.text: An introduction to the book of Psalms.
Psalms is a compilation of sacred songs,
which have been an important feature of true worship
that highlight giving praise to Jehovah.
In fact, God’s name, Jehovah,
and a shortened form of it, Jah,
appear almost 800 times throughout the book.
The writing of the book of Psalms
spanned about 1,000 years.
Moses is considered
to be the earliest composer.
The Psalms were compiled
after the return of the Jews to Jerusalem
from Babylonian exile,
apparently by the scribe Ezra.
Although Jehovah inspired such men as Solomon,
the sons of Korah, the house of Asaph, and others
to pen these moving expressions of faith,
more than half of the psalms are attributed to David.
The different experiences in David’s life
provided the background for many of the psalms.
The headings, or superscriptions,
found at the beginning of many psalms
identify the writer and give other information about the psalm.
The book is made up of 150 chapters.
It is the largest book of the Bible.
The Psalms were compiled
into five separate books, or volumes.
Several themes are developed
in these lyrical works.
Consider just three of them.
Praise to Jehovah is a recurring theme.
Many psalms praise Jehovah for his saving acts.
Other psalms praise Jehovah for his creative works,
from the marvels of the human body to the earth and seas.
Psalm 83 praises Jehovah
as the Most High over all the earth.
Another theme developed in Psalms
is that Jehovah helps
and comforts those who love him.
Jehovah is referred to
as the “Hearer of prayer”
and as a merciful Father, who pardons repentant sinners.
Psalm 23 describes Jehovah as a loving Shepherd,
who guides, protects, and cares for his people.
An additional theme
is that Jehovah will transform the earth
into a paradise
by means of the Messianic Kingdom.
This Kingdom will remove all wickedness
and bring peace to the earth.
Certain psalms are grouped together.
For example, Psalms 113 to 118
form the group called the Hallel Psalms.
Did you know?
It is likely that Jesus and his disciples sang these very psalms
after the Lord’s Evening Meal.
Psalms 120 to 134
are called the Songs of the Ascents.
Many believe these psalms were sung
as the Israelites ascended to Jerusalem
to attend the three great annual festivals.
The last five psalms form a group
in which each begins and ends
with the words “Praise Jah!”
An important feature of Psalms
is that it contains numerous prophecies
about the Messiah.
Jesus himself said:
“All the things written about me in the . . . Psalms must be fulfilled.”
As you read the book of Psalms,
take note of how it supports Jehovah’s sovereignty,
how Jehovah helps and comforts those who love him,
and how Jehovah will transform the earth into a paradise
by means of his Messianic Kingdom.

耶和华是听祷告的主
也是怜悯人的父亲
他乐意赦免悔改的罪人
第23篇形容
耶和华是仁爱的牧者
时刻引导
保护和关怀他的子民
还有一个主题
是耶和华会通过弥赛亚王国
使地球成为乐园
这个王国
会消除一切邪恶的事
为世界带来和平
有些诗歌被汇整在一起
例如，诗篇113到118篇
又被称为颂赞诗篇
你知道吗？
耶稣和使徒
很可能在主的晚餐后
唱出这些颂赞诗篇
诗篇120到134篇
则被称为登城的歌
每年三大节期
以色列人上山前往耶路撒冷守节时
都会唱这些歌
诗篇的最后五篇
都以“要赞美耶和华”
作为开头和结尾
诗篇的一个重要特色
是当中包含了
许多跟弥赛亚有关的预言
耶稣自己也说
诗篇上关于我的话
都必定应验
当你阅读诗篇时
请留意
经文如何强调耶和华的至高统治权
以及耶和华怎样帮助
并安慰那些爱他的人
还有，耶和华会怎样借着弥赛亚王国
使地球成为乐园

titles.cn: 诗篇简介

ko.text: ‎‪멀리 떨어진 곳까지 간 이 가족의 이야기를 통해,
‎‪그런 결정이 어떻게 가족의 믿음을 강하게 해 주었는지 보실 겁니다.
‎‪하지만 결혼은 이르다는 걸 여러분 자신도 알죠.
‎‪자연스레 생기는 그러한 감정을 어떻게 잘 제어할 수 있을까요?
‎‪에리히 프로스트 형제의 아주 흥미로운 경험담도 있습니다.
‎‪그와 동료 형제들은 믿음을 유지하도록 서로를 돕기 위해 어떻게 했을까요?
‎‪가족의 영적 건강을 튼튼하게 지키는 중요한 한가지 방법은
‎‪다음 동영상에서 가장이 어떻게 가족 성원 각자의 필요를 이해하고
‎‪몇 주 전에 가족이 함께 앉아 저녁을 먹고 있었습니다.
‎‪세라는 옷차림에 대해 우리가 너무 엄격하다고 생각했고,
‎‪그리고 세라를 야외 봉사에 데리고 나가기가 점점 힘이 듭니다.
‎‪늘 이랬던 건 아닌데, 전에는 봉사 나가는 걸 좋아했거든요.
‎‪그런데 갑자기, 학교 친구 휴대폰에 있는 게임에 정신이 팔렸습니다.
‎‪늘 초능력을 쓰는 내용의 게임인데 거기에 홀딱 빠졌죠,
‎‪잠 자러 가거나 자기 방 치우는 걸 싫어했죠.
‎‪말해 줘야 할 게 몇 가지 있다는 걸 깨달았습니다.
‎‪그날 저녁, 남편과 함께 아이들 이야기를 많이 했어요.
‎‪다음 날, 아이들에게 가족 숭배 때 노아를 주제로 하면 어떻겠냐고 물었죠.
‎‪저는 마이크와 톰과 함께 방주를 만들기로 했죠.
‎‪그리고 세라는 우리 출판물에서 그 내용에 관한 삽화를 수집했어요.
‎‪우리 가족에게 어떻게 도움이 될지 다시 생각해 봤죠.
‎‪노아와 그 가족이 어떤 세상에서 살았는지 이야기했죠.
‎‪노아의 가족이 전파하는 데는 진정한 용기가 필요했어요.
‎‪그런 일은 일어난 적이 한 번도 없었거든요.
‎‪그래서 노아는 여호와를 친구로서 굳게 신뢰할 수 있었죠.
‎‪아빠는 그 당시 세상이 아주 악했다고 하셨어요.
‎‪늘 싸움이 벌어져서 겁에 질린 사람이 많았기 때문에,
‎‪‘그리고 모든 부류의 생물을 두 마리씩 방주 안으로 데리고 들어가라.’
‎‪아빠가 동물들이 어떻게 방주로 들어갔는지 보여 줬어요.
‎‪다 자기 자리가 있어서, 엉망이 되지 않고 두 마리씩 들어갔어요.
‎‪그 방주처럼 우리의 방도 깨끗이 정리해야 한다고 설명해 주었죠.
‎‪우리 가족은 창세기 6:22의 말씀을 마음에 새기고 싶었습니다.
‎‪그다음엔 비가 왔지만, 우리 가족은 다 살아남았어요!
‎‪결코 포기하지 않았다는 걸 우리 모두 배웠어요.
‎‪그러려면 이런 가족 숭배를 정기적으로 해야 합니다.
‎‪가족 숭배가 얼마나 유익한 점이 많은지 잘 보여 주지 않습니까?
‎‪함께 모여 하늘의 아버지에 대해 더 많이 배울 수 있다는 분명한 사실 외에도
‎‪자녀들은 각자 생활에 적용할 수 있는 점을 배울 수 있었죠.
‎‪여러 해 동안 많은 부가적인 봉사의 특권을 수행해 왔습니다.
‎‪두 분이 가족에 대한 사탄의 공격에 지금까지 성공적으로 맞서 왔기 때문입니다.
‎‪우선 형제가 가족 소개를 좀 해 주시죠.
‎‪저희 둘 다 진리 안에서 자라지 않았어요.
‎‪당시 전 결혼할 입장이 아니어서 우린 2년간 연애만 하다가
‎‪얼마 안 되 둘 다 성서 연구 시작했죠.
‎‪일주일에 두 번씩 했고 진리라는 걸 알게 되었습니다.
‎‪아내 부모님이 아내가 계속 세속 교육을 받길 원했어요.
‎‪저흰 행실을 변화할 필요가 있었고 2년이 지나 필요한 조정을 했습니다.
‎‪가족이 훌륭한 기초를 쌓고 성공적이 되게 하기 위해
‎‪침례를 받기 전에, 남편은 음주 문제가 심각했어요.
‎‪또 자란 배경 때문에, 저희는 질투심이 많았고,
‎‪「행복한 가정을 이루는 길」 책을 공부하자고 제안했고,
‎‪이 출판물과 그 안에 든 성경 원칙들이
‎‪지금 저희가 즐기는 행복한 결혼 생활의 기초가 되었습니다.
‎‪그러면, 오르티스 형제가 자녀들에 관해서 좀 이야기를 해 주시겠습니까?
‎‪큰 아들 게이브리얼은 열네 살 때 정규 파이오니아를 시작했고,
‎‪스물두 살인데 지금까지 2년 넘게 워릭 현장 배관부에서 일해 왔습니다.
‎‪마찬가지로 열네 살 때 정규 파이오니아를 시작했고,
‎‪지금은 회중 회계 일을 비롯한 다른 특권들도 즐기고 있죠.
‎‪둘 다 일찍부터 신권 경력을 쌓기 시작했군요.
‎‪조롱하는 자에게 형제의 아들들이 대답하는 걸 보고 기뻐하실 거라 확신합니다.
‎‪가정 책에 더해서 가족이 성공을 거두는 데 도움이 된 것이 또 있었나요?
‎‪중앙장로회는 많은 출판물을 통해 가족을 위한 지침을 제공해 왔죠.
‎‪그래서 궁금한 점이나 문제가 있을 때마다 늘 신속하게 결정을 내릴 수 있었어요.
‎‪서로 대화하거나 아이들에게 조언할 적절한 때를 알 수 있게 인도해 달라고도 기도하죠.
‎‪아이들의 삶과 인격 발달에는 구분되는 단계들이 있다고 들었기 때문에,
‎‪어떤 일을 예상할 수 있을지 미리 조사했어요.
‎‪그랬기 때문에 아이들의 태도나 생각이 바뀌는 걸 볼 때도 놀라지 않았습니다.
‎‪또 아이들의 성장 단계에서 어떤 문제가 있는지,
‎‪조정이나 시정이 필요한 부분이 무엇인지 알 수 있었어요.
‎‪잘 들어 주고 이해해 주는 게 얼마나 중요한지를 여러 해 동안 배웠습니다.
‎‪함께 성경을 연구하는 시간을 아주 소중히 여겼습니다.
‎‪태아가 6개월만 되어도 가족의 목소리를 인지할 수 있다는 걸 알게 되었고,
‎‪그래서 아들들이 엄마 배 속에 있을 때부터 성서 연구를 시작했죠.
‎‪세속 일이나 다른 활동이 정기적인 가족 숭배를 방해할 때가 있는데,
‎‪가족 숭배를 성공적으로 하려면 그런 상황과 싸워야 했죠.
‎‪형제 가족이 영적으로 얼마나 잘 해 왔고
‎‪서로 얼마나 친밀한 관계를 누리고 있는지 보면 말이죠.
‎‪고린도 전서 10:13은 우리가 ‘모든 사람이 일반적으로 겪는’ 어려움에 직면할 거라고 했죠.
‎‪저희도 가족을 부양할 때 오는 어려움들을 겪어 왔어요.
‎‪같은 성구에선 우리가 여호와의 방식대로 일을 처리하면
‎‪그분이 “빠져 나갈 길을 마련해” 주실 가능성이 높아진다는 점을 알려 주죠.
‎‪저희 가족에게 큰 변화를 초래한, 예상치 못했던 어려움 한 가지는
‎‪가족과 결혼 생활에 큰 긴장이 초래되었고 영성에도 영향을 주었죠.
‎‪하지만 여호와께 끊임없이 기도하고 성경 원칙을 적용한 덕분에
‎‪지금 저희 결혼 생활과 가족의 상태는 더할 나위 없이 좋아요.
‎‪영적 일과를 유지했고, 시련을 겪으면서도 가족 모두 전 시간 봉사를 놓지 않았죠.
‎‪우릴 도와 돈 버는 일을 하겠다고 했죠.
‎‪하지만 여호와께서 필요한 걸 더해 주실 거라고 확신하기 때문에
‎‪저희는 아이들이 왕국에 계속 초점을 맞추길 바래요.
‎‪남편은 영적 일과를 계속 확고히 유지하는 면에서
‎‪불평하거나 낙담해 있는 걸 본 적이 없어요.
‎‪4월 프로그램에 나온 대회 동영상 드라마 예고편을 보시고 분명 공감이 되셨겠군요.
‎‪오르티스 형제, 몸 상태에 대해 듣고 안타까웠습니다.
‎‪영적으로 계속 활발하고 강한 상태를 유지하는 데 도움이 된,
‎‪건강 문제를 극복할 힘을 얻기 위해 여호와께 끊임 없이 기도드렸습니다.
‎‪그리고 그 성구에선 그분이 우리에게 정신의 평화를 주실 거라고 말하죠.
‎‪또 아내가 돌보는 일이 정말 많다는 걸 잘 압니다.
‎‪거기 보면 훌륭한 아내가 가족을 위해 맡고 있는 책임들이 나오는데,
‎‪모리스 형제, 이건 바로 저희 자매 얘깁니다!
‎‪두 분이 서로를 얼마나 사랑하고 존중하는지 분명히 알겠네요.
‎‪또 부모로서 최선을 다해 온 두 분의 노력이
‎‪이 프로그램을 시청하는 부모들에게 좋은 본이 될 겁니다.
‎‪자 그럼, 두 분에겐 말씀을 드리지 않았지만,
‎‪두 아들을 초대해서 자랄 때 기억나는 일들을 들어 보죠.
‎‪모든 집회에 빠지지 않고 참석했던 거랑 토요일마다 봉사에 나갔던 기억이 나요.
‎‪말씀하셨듯이 가족 숭배를 정기적으로 하는 게 쉽진 않았던 것 같아요.
‎‪그러니까 가족간에도 점점 더 가까워지게 된 것 같습니다.
‎‪잘 됐네요. 에이드리언도 할 말이 있을 텐데요?
‎‪어머니와 아버지는 여호와께뿐 아니라 서로 간에도 항상 큰 사랑을 보이셨어요.
‎‪사랑과 존중심이 어떤 건지 배울 수 있었어요.
‎‪형과 전 지금도 서로 사이가 아주 좋아요.
‎‪서로를 사랑하고 서로 간에 숨기는 게 없죠.
‎‪다 부모님이 보여 주신 사랑과 존중심 덕분이에요.
‎‪서로 의견이 다를 때도 있죠. 불완전한 가족이니까요.
‎‪하지만 항상 사랑으로 그런 차이들을 메꾸곤 해요.
‎‪한 가지 더 말하면, 제가 학교에 가기 전에
‎‪항상 아버지와 했던 게 있는데 그게 큰 도움이 됐어요.
‎‪여호와께서 절 사랑하신다는 걸 기억하고 행동하라고 늘 말씀하셨죠.
‎‪그게 얼마나 도움이 됐는지 아버진 잘 모르실 거예요.
‎‪열네 살밖에 안 되었을 때 정규 파이오니아를 시작하게 된 계기가 무엇인가요?
‎‪아버진 그 문제에만 매달려 고민하지 않고 영적인 관점으로 사물을 보셨죠.
‎‪저랑 스케줄이 딱 맞길래, 제가 아버지의 파이오니아 짝이 되기로 했죠.
‎‪느낀 게 있는데 영적인 가족이 영적인 일에 집중하면
‎‪서로 간의 존중심과 가족 사이가 이렇게 좋았던 때는 없는 거 같습니다.
‎‪가족이 다 파이오니아였고, 늘 같이 봉사에 나가다 보니
‎‪저도 파이오니아 시간을 거의 다 하고 있더라고요.
‎‪하지만 매달 봉사에 70시간 이상을 바치는 책임을 받아들이니까
‎‪열네 살짜리 청소년으로선 하기 어려운 생각을 하게 되는 것 같아요.
‎‪회중에서 잠재력을 온전히 발휘하는 데 도움이 됐어요.
‎‪가족을 예전처럼 부양할 수 없을 거란 걸 알게 되었을 때
‎‪지금까지 겪은 일 중에 가장 힘들었던 것 같아요.
‎‪아버지가 암 진단을 받았을 때 즈음에 전 베델에 초대를 받았어요.
‎‪이렇게 가족이 힘든 때 집을 떠나 베델에 가는 건
‎‪하지만 저희 가족은 늘 영적인 관점으로 사물을 보았고
‎‪덕분에 가족 전체가 왕국 권익을 첫째로 두면
‎‪사랑 많은 아버지이신 여호와께서 부양해 주실 거란 걸 깨닫게 되었죠.
